breakdown.description: Saturation temperature is inconsistent with the stated condenser pressure (10 kPa does not correspond to 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses Tsat ≈ 45.8°C for a condenser pressure of 10 kPa, matching the ground truth. It does not repeat the user's erroneous claim that Tsat = 100°C at 10 kPa.
